# Fluentic Style

> @fluentic/style is a typed styling library for element styles, reusable component slots, scope-based overrides, themeable tokens and app values. Author in TypeScript; use a bundler plugin for production CSS extraction while retaining dynamic styles.

Documentation target: 0.1.0-beta.12. Start with Setup and Core for new implementations. For migrations, also read the common migration contract and the matching source guide. Fetch only relevant guides; the complete guide is available for clients that need one file. These files focus on implementation and omit debugging workflows.

Reading paths:
- New app: Setup → your bundler → Core → Complete example when you need runnable code.
- Migration: also read Migration contract → only your source library guide.
- Read Extensions and interop only for custom builders or third-party boundaries.
- Fetch each guide once. Use the complete file instead of individual guides, not in addition to them.

Quick install (choose the project's package manager):

```sh
npm install @fluentic/style
# or: pnpm add @fluentic/style
# or: yarn add @fluentic/style
# or: bun add @fluentic/style
```

Supported production integrations: Vite, Webpack, Rspack, Parcel 2, Farm, and Next.js App Router (Webpack and Turbopack). Install the package, then follow the matching bundler guide below to enable the css prop and production extraction. Installing alone does not configure JSX. For React runtime-only use @fluentic/style/jsx; plugin builds use @fluentic/style/plugin/jsx. Preact and Solid retain their framework JSX transforms; see Setup.

Use style() for one element; style.slot() for public component parts; style.scope() for variants and outside part overrides; combineStyle() and bindScope() at component boundaries. Use component tokens for named contracts, createValues() for themeable app literals, and createTheme() for app/subtree token overrides. Keep complete extractable chains, put consumer root css last, and preserve state, responsive and accessibility behavior. Do not invent APIs or assume a source styling library's cascade and defaults match Fluentic.

## Implementation

- [Setup](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/setup.txt): Installation, framework/JSX choices, integration selection and shared production requirements. Read first.
- [Core](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/core.txt): Styles, composition, selectors, slots, scopes, component contracts, tokens, values, themes and priority. Read for every implementation.
- [Complete example](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/example.txt): Runnable React/Vite project generated from checked source; tokens, slots, variants, app themes and consumer overrides.
- [Extensions and interop](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/advanced.txt): Custom builders, compiler registration, className/style boundaries and CSS at-rules. Read only when needed.

## Bundler setup

- [Vite](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/vite.txt): React starter, plugin order and JSX configuration.
- [Next.js](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/nextjs.txt): App Router adapter for Webpack and Turbopack, RSC and layout wiring.
- [Webpack](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/webpack.txt): Babel JSX configuration, CSS loaders and extraction.
- [Rspack](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/rspack.txt): SWC JSX configuration and native CSS support.
- [Parcel 2](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/parcel.txt): Bundled Parcel configuration and JSX setup.
- [Farm](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/integrations/farm.txt): React plugin configuration and Fluentic adapter.

## Migrations

- [Migration contract](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/common.txt): Shared sequence, coexistence rules and parity acceptance checks. Read before a source-specific guide.
- [Plain CSS](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/css.txt): Selectors, custom properties, globals and cascade.
- [CSS Modules](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/css-modules.txt): Local classes, composes and public component parts.
- [vanilla-extract](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/vanilla-extract.txt): Theme contracts, recipes, sprinkles and dynamic variables.
- [Panda CSS](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/panda.txt): Conditions, tokens, patterns and slot recipes.
- [StyleX](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/stylex.txt): Conditional properties, variable themes, dynamic styles and composition.
- [Emotion and styled-components](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/emotion.txt): Styled wrappers, interpolation, providers, JSX coexistence and SSR.
- [Tailwind CSS](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms/migrations/tailwind.txt): Utilities, variants, resets, app configuration and optional Fluentic Tailwind presets.

## Optional

- [Complete guide](https://fluenticstack.com/style/llms-full.txt): All guides in one plain-text file; use instead of fetching individual files when attaching context to an agent.
